stories.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
stories.body: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

stories.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
stories.body: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.

stories.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
stories.body: The comments come as Argentinian president Javier Milei says the "winds of change" favoured his country's claim on the British overseas territory.

stories.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
stories.body: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

stories.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
stories.body: The Australian icon was killed in 2006, after a stingray's barb pierced his chest during filming.

stories.title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
stories.body: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have led President Donald Trump's efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war - but talks have stalled.

stories.title: Argentine couple to return Nazi-looted painting to rightful owner
stories.body: The late-baroque Portrait of a Lady was lost for 80 years until it was spotted in photographs of a house for sale near Buenos Aires.

stories.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
stories.body: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - the US the only nation to vote against it.

stories.title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
stories.body: Fuel prices have soared since the Iran conflict began at the end of February, mirroring the surge in wholesale oil prices.

stories.title: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
stories.body: King Oyo died in the US last week aged 34 after receiving treatment for an aggressive form of cancer.

stories.title: 100 influencers invited to US Open spark debate on 'tennis etiquette'
stories.body: The behaviour of influencers and content creators has become a major talking point at this year's US Open amid incidents of matches being disrupted.

stories.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
stories.body: A man has lived for a record nine months with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human transplant.

stories.title: Volkswagen board approves plan to cut another 50,000 jobs
stories.body: The group - which includes Audi, Porsche, Skoda as well as the VW brand - plans to cut a total of 100,000 posts by 2030.

stories.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
stories.body: The Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) said shrapnel from a missile hit the ceremony and killed four people on Tuesday.

stories.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
stories.body: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

stories.title: Around 2,000 fall ill in Indonesia after eating free school meals
stories.body: Authorities are investigating several suspected outbreaks amid growing criticism of the scheme.

stories.title: US billionaire Leon Black defies summons and sues Epstein panel
stories.body: The lawsuit calls the House Oversight Committee's subpoenas, which ordered him to share nondisclosure agreements, "invalid".

stories.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
stories.body: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

stories.title: Nepal bet nearly everything on hydropower - the floods show why that's a problem
stories.body: More than 10% of Nepal's energy generation capacity was knocked out by last week's floods.

stories.title: 'Layer upon layer of miracles' to find tunnel survivors, Nepal rescue adviser tells BBC
stories.body: From searching for a buried tunnel entrance to blowing up rocks the size of cars, rescuers had to surmount multiple challenges to reach survivors.
